title: How often should I get my air conditioner serviced in Al Badaa?
desc: Most home air conditioning systems need to be looked at every 6 months. It really depends on how much you use it and the weather outside.

title: Do you fix air conditioners for offices and other commercial properties?
desc: Yes, you can get your air conditioner fixed for offices, restaurants, shops, clinics and other commercial buildings in Al Badaa.

title: Can I get my air conditioner fixed on the day in Al Badaa?
desc: You might be able to get same-day service. It depends on when the technicians are available and what needs to be fixed on your air conditioner.

title: Why is water leaking from my air conditioner?
desc:
There are some reasons this can happen including:
  • Blocked drain pipes
  • Frozen evaporator coils
  • Dirty air filters

title: What is included in the AC maintenance service?
desc:
Maintenance usually includes:
  • Filter cleaning
  • Coil inspection
  • Drain cleaning
  • Thermostat testing
  • Performance checks

title: Which AC brands do you service?
desc:

  • Daikin

  • York
  • Mitsubishi
  • Gree, and many others.

title: Is it worth getting a maintenance contract for my air conditioner system?
desc: Yes, getting a maintenance contract every year really helps reduce the number of times your air conditioner breaks down. It also helps your air conditioner system work better in the long run.

title: Why is my air conditioner making so much noise?
desc:
Some common reasons include:
  • Loose internal components
  • Fan motor issues
  • Dirt buildup inside the system

title: Can AC cleaning improve indoor air quality?
desc: Yes, removing dust and pollutants from the system helps create cleaner indoor air.

title: How long does an AC maintenance visit usually take?
desc: Most maintenance visits take around one hour depending on the condition and number of units.

title: Do you provide warranty on AC services?
desc: Yes, cleaning and maintenance services include a 60-day service warranty.

title: Can regular servicing reduce electricity bills?
desc: Yes, efficient air conditioning systems use less energy and often result in lower monthly electricity costs.

title: How can I book an AC service appointment?
desc: Simply contact our team via WhatsApp and Gmail with your location, preferred time and a suitable visit can be arranged.
